$comment: VOIID design tokens — NOCTURNE. Dark-first: a deep aubergine spine and a single warm amber, with light as the variant rather than the default. Replaces PEACOCK (teal #0E6F68 / ember #C25022); the token NAMES are unchanged, so every call site followed automatically. MIRROR, NOT SOURCE: the shipped values live in apps/ios/Voiid/Voiid/DesignSystem/Theme.swift and apps/android/app/src/main/java/com/voiid/app/ui/theme/Color.kt — this file tracks them, and iOS is the reference when the two disagree. Every colour is a {light,dark} pair: the app supports both themes plus a Light/Dark/System override, so a single-valued token cannot describe the design. Contrast ratios are measured against the ground each token sits on; UI surfaces target 3:1 and text 4.5:1 (WCAG AA).

$parity.$comment: Known drift between the two clients, as of 2026-08-06. Recorded so it is visible rather than discovered.
$parity.note: Android's Color.kt defines 41 tokens and omits the three above; it also has no separate chat domain hue, since chat resolves to primary. Adding them to Color.kt would bring the two clients level.

color.$comment: SPINE — deep aubergine carries every primary action and is the brand colour. It LIFTS in dark (#2E2440 → #B59BE0) because one fixed value always fails one of the two grounds: the deep aubergine is legible as text on the light ground, unreadable on near-black.

game.$comment: Per-game surfaces. Ludo (LUDO_GAME_SPEC.md §2): the dark board reference's graphite cells with lifted/desaturated player hues so pieces stay distinct without glowing. Mirrored EXACTLY in iOS DesignSystem/Theme.swift (LudoTokens) and Android ui/theme Color.kt/Dimens.kt.

background.$comment: lilac-tinted off-white / near-black with a violet cast. Dark is the DESIGNED state here; light is the variant.

sent.$comment: dark is #7862A6, NOT the palette study's #4A3B66: that measured 1.96:1 against the ground and 1.75:1 against the received bubble, so consecutive messages had no visible boundary at all.

received.$comment: the quiet one, so the eye tracks your own thread down the screen

textOnSent.$comment: fixed in both themes because the fill is dark in both. A touch brighter than the study's #F2ECFA, which measured 4.43:1 on the dark bubble — just under AA — because lifting the bubble to #7862A6 also lifted what the text has to beat. 4.75:1 now, 13.49:1 on light.

card.$comment: cards, sheets, raised rows — one step up from the ground

divider.$comment: must RECEDE — quieter than an accent, or nothing in the UI has hierarchy

accent.$comment: AMBER — the one warm counterweight (unread badges, live dots, the one thing that must be seen). Used sparingly; its power is entirely in its rarity. THEME-SPLIT because the bright value measured only 1.88:1 on the light ground — an unread badge that effectively vanished — and failed white text at 2.16:1. The light value gives 3.40:1 as a surface and 4.14:1 for dark text on it; dark keeps the bright value at 9.06:1. NOTE: the light value clears 3:1 as a SURFACE but not 4.5:1 as text — use text.primary for words on an amber fill, and deepen the hue if amber is ever needed as large text.

domain.$comment: Section identity ONLY — icons, empty states, headers. Never bubbles or body text. Rotations of one lightness and chroma, which is what makes five hues read as one family.

chat.$comment: resolves to primary; Android has no separate token for this

status.$comment: Semantic, and deliberately separate from the accent. State must NEVER be carried by hue alone — roughly 1 in 12 men has a colour-vision deficiency, so a missed call is red AND carries its icon and label.

onlineText.$comment: online-presence green, used where the word 'Online' is TEXT rather than a fill. Darker than success in light on purpose: success is 4.61:1 on the light ground — a pass, but only just — and this is read in the chat toolbar, which is translucent Liquid Glass, so the real backdrop is whatever bubble or photo is scrolling underneath. 6.58:1 keeps it legible against a white bubble (7.55:1) as well as the ground. Dark keeps success unchanged, already 9.38:1. iOS only.

dimension.$comment: Ludo geometry (LUDO_GAME_SPEC.md §2.2). pt on iOS, dp on Android.

motion.$comment: Ludo motion contract (LUDO_GAME_SPEC.md §12–§15). Durations in ms; cubic-bezier control points. Reduced motion replaces every entry with an instant/opacity change.

typography.$comment: SF Pro Rounded (iOS) / equivalent rounded face (Android). EXCEPTION, per design owner: the 'voiid' wordmark on the Splash and Terms screens uses Urbanist Bold and is kept exactly as designed. Sizes in pt.
